plugin.name: Performance Guardian
plugin.description: While a chosen app (Delta Force by default) is running, stop N.E.K.O's UI rendering, close rebuildable helper processes and trim memory to cut RAM/GPU usage, then fully restore everything when the app exits or the plugin is stopped.
entry.status.name: Show guardian status
entry.status.description: Show whether throttling is active, the trigger apps, suspended/closed processes and current switches.
entry.enable_saver.name: Enable auto guardian
entry.enable_saver.description: Enable auto mode: throttle N.E.K.O while the chosen app runs and restore automatically when it exits.
entry.disable_saver.name: Disable auto guardian
entry.disable_saver.description: Disable auto mode and immediately restore every suspended process (the plugin itself keeps running).
entry.toggle_saver.name: Toggle auto guardian
entry.toggle_saver.description: Switch auto mode on/off; turning it off restores suspended processes immediately.
entry.apply_now.name: Throttle now
entry.apply_now.description: Throttle N.E.K.O right now without waiting for the trigger app.
entry.restore_now.name: Restore now
entry.set_target_processes.name: Set trigger apps
entry.set_target_processes.description: Set the trigger process names, separated by commas or newlines; '*' wildcards are supported.
entry.set_option.name: Change a setting
entry.set_option.description: Change a plugin switch such as freeze_renderers / close_audio_service / trim_working_set / lower_priority.
entry.set_option.param.key: Setting name (see the [perf_saver] section in plugin.toml)
entry.set_option.param.value: New value: true/false for switches, integer for seconds, comma-separated for lists
entry.diagnose.name: Environment diagnosis
entry.diagnose.description: Report the runtime environment: process enumeration backend, detected N.E.K.O processes and whether the trigger app is running.
entry.get_disclaimer.name: Show disclaimer
entry.get_disclaimer.description: Read-only: show the pre-use disclaimer text and whether it has already been acknowledged (required=true means the panel will warn again).
entry.acknowledge_disclaimer.name: Acknowledge disclaimer
entry.acknowledge_disclaimer.description: Acknowledge that you have read the pre-use disclaimer; with 'don't remind me again' the acknowledgement is written to the plugin config.
entry.acknowledge_disclaimer.param.dont_: Whether to never remind again: true = persist the acknowledgement and stop warning; false = understood this time, warn again next time (nothing is written)
disclaimer.title: Please read before use (anti-cheat notice)
disclaimer.text: This plugin does not guarantee that it will not trigger the game's anti-cheat system, and you are responsible for any consequences of using it.
disclaimer.note: With the reminder option ticked and continue ⇒ the panel will not warn again; left unticked ⇒ this session is allowed and the panel warns again next time (the plugin config is authoritative).
disclaimer.cached: Last acknowledged at {at} (the local cache is only a hint; the plugin config decides whether to warn again).
disclaimer.errTitle: Could not read the pre-use notice
disclaimer.errBody:
Failed to read the pre-use notice: {message}
Until it is acknowledged, the panel's action buttons stay disabled.
disclaimer.blocked: Please acknowledge the pre-use notice before using the panel.
disclaimer.ackOk.once: allowed this time, you will be reminded again
config.title: Configuration
config.intro: These 7 options are the plugin config itself: saving applies them immediately, and the values shown here are always read back from the plugin (nothing is hard-coded in the panel).
config.previewNote: Preview is computed entirely inside this page: it lists the entries and arguments that WOULD be sent, plus the old -> new values, and sends no request at all (zero requests, so the config stays byte-for-byte identical). This panel does not offer a server-side dry-run: the plugin's set_option only honours dry_run for close_extra_processes, for every other key dry_run is ignored and the value is written anyway, and set_target_processes has no dry_run parameter at all. A preview built on that would silently change the config, so this panel never sends one. Values are only written when you click Save config.
config.previewHead: --- Entries and arguments that WOULD be sent ({count}; preview only, nothing sent) ---
config.previewPlanned: Preview (not sent): {count} item(s) pending save; the {count} request(s) above are only sent when you click Save config.
config.previewZero: (Zero requests: everything above is computed locally in the page; no set_option / set_target_processes / status entry was called. Nothing is sent until you click Save config.)
config.noneChanged: No changes detected, no write entry was called.
config.notReady: The plugin config has not been read yet (the status entry did not answer successfully); use Status refresh before saving.
config.previewNoChange: Preview (not sent): no changes, so Save config would send no write request either (0 requests this time).
config.err.empty: Enter at least one trigger app. An empty value would make the plugin clear the list, so the panel refuses to send it.
config.err.emptyItem: Item {index} is empty: separate process names with a single comma or newline (e.g. a.exe,b.exe).
config.err.wildcard: Wildcard pattern {pattern} is too broad: at least 3 characters are required before the first wildcard (e.g. extra*.exe).
config.loaded: Current config read back from the plugin.
config.opt.saver_enabled.hint: When off the plugin stays idle and never throttles on its own; you can still run Apply now once.
config.opt.target_processes.hint: One per line or comma separated; case-insensitive, * wildcards allowed (e.g. extra*.exe). An empty value is blocked with a message - the panel never sends an empty list.
config.opt.freeze_gpu.hint: Limited benefit and Chromium has a watchdog; off by default.
config.opt.close_video_capture_service.h: That process can be rebuilt automatically; on by default.
config.opt.close_audio_service.hint: It silences N.E.K.O; off by default.
config.opt.skip_while_neko_foreground: Restore while N.E.K.O is in the foreground
config.opt.skip_while_neko_foreground.hi: Restore when the N.E.K.O window comes to the front, throttle again when it leaves; on by default.
config.opt.restore_on_target_exit: Restore when the target app exits
config.opt.restore_on_target_exit.hint: Restores N.E.K.O as soon as the target app exits; on by default.
